temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara observes Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say the loss has been tough, that she keeps wondering if more could have been done, and that it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is a caring colleague who is also mourning the mutual patient, but she does not yet know how deeply Shirley is affected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed, and she learns Shirley also feels some lingering responsibility and difficulty letting go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is grieving deeply, feels some responsibility for the patient's death, and is struggling to accept the loss.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Compassion, concern, and sadness for Shirley
temporal_state_chain.intention: Sara wants to comfort and reassure Shirley, reminding her of the good care they provided and helping her cope with the loss.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara senses Shirley feels burdened by the outcome, and Shirley explicitly says she feels responsible and wonders if pushing for a different treatment approach might have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving, may feel some responsibility, and is struggling to let go after the patient's death.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara's belief is confirmed and deepened: Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome and is second-guessing treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley carries a heavy sense of responsibility and guilt about the treatment decisions, and that reassurance helps but Shirley still finds it hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathy, concern, and a desire to ease Shirley's guilt
temporal_state_chain.intention: Sara wants to alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by discussing the treatment decisions and affirming that they made the best choices with the information available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley continuing to be reserved and showing minimal emotion, then confronts her and learns Shirley fears seeming unprofessional or weak if she opens up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their coffee-break talk, Sara believes Shirley is grieving, feels responsible, and remains emotionally guarded despite Sara's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara learns that Shirley's reserve is driven by fear of appearing unprofessional or weak, and that Shirley may be willing to try being more open.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley holds back her feelings because she fears judgment, but Shirley is at least willing to try expressing herself more openly among friends.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and mild worry about having confronted Shirley
temporal_state_chain.intention: Sara wants to encourage Shirley to express her emotions and reassure her that showing feelings is healthy and not a sign of weakness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong in their last conversation; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and worries it may have strained their friendship, even though Shirley seemed willing to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara learns Shirley felt her approach was a bit much but understands Sara's good intentions and accepts the apology.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes their friendship can be mended, that Shirley values her support, and that continued talking will help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Sara wants to mend the friendship, be available for Shirley in whatever way she needs, and continue supportive conversations.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better, asks how she is feeling, and learns Shirley feels better because of their talks and Sara's support. Shirley agrees to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been gradually improving, values their conversations, and is open to receiving support, though she may still be healing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Sara's belief is confirmed: Shirley is doing better, credits their talks and Sara's support, and is willing to spend more time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Sara believes Shirley is improving, that her support has helped, and that their friendship can deepen through spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Sara wants to continue supporting Shirley and plan a weekend activity together to further strengthen their friendship and Shirley's well-being.
